The Syndicate has been negatively impacted by adverse development, resulting in strengthening of specific reserves in relation to Ukraine losses during the calendar year, largely on 2021 year of account, on both gross and net basis. The current estimate of potential losses included within our net reserves for the war in Ukraine for the year ended 31 December 2024 are GBP 16.0m (2023: GBP 12.3m).

The report does not explicitly detail the causes for the overall release.
